name: Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County
subtitle: Stand assignment and push control for the McNamara Terminal (Concourses A, B, C), Evans Terminal D and the hardstands
source: Stands and headings, taxiways, aprons and buildings from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): each stand 20 m back from the jet-bridge end of its lead-in line. Gate list, Delta Ramp Control sectors and frequencies, hold circles 1S-4S / 1N-4N, taxi hold points 1-8, Evans Ramp Tower and the hardstand areas from the Jeppesen 10-9B to 10-9E (13 and 27 FEB 26, user-supplied). C26 and C28-C38, which OSM lacks, continue their rows evenly to the concourse's north tip (C38 off the tip), as the 10-9B packs them. The Area C and Area D hardstands are placed from their chart labels (frame ticks: 10-9B ~3.5 m/px, 10-9D ~2.4 m/px). OSM's '22' is C20, D3A / D3B are D3 / D3W. Generated frames: north up, 1.5 m/px, linear in lat/lon.

airlinesSource: Approximate: Delta and its SkyTeam partners at the McNamara Terminal (mainline on Concourse A, Delta Connection on B and C), all other airlines at the Evans Terminal (Concourse D). Hardstands are not given out automatically.
notes: Delta Ramp Control: A Concourse West 130.75 (U9), Southeast 121.125 (J7, J8), Northeast 123.675 (U7, U8), East Corridor odd gates 127.825 (Q), West Corridor even gates 121.8 (K), De-Ice Ramp 130.85 (J11), A76-A78 121.8.
Ground Control (121.8) gives pushback for A76-A78, B2-B20 even, C2-C38 even, and D2, D4, D30, D32. D9 and D10 call Ground for wingspans 171 ft up to 214 ft.
Evans Ramp Tower 130.8 for Terminal D. Taxi hold points 1-8 on taxilane E.
Hold circles 1S-4S and 1N-4N mark the ends of the South Ramp taxilanes. Hold spots on the taxilanes and 3W are on the 10-9B, not drawn here.
Hardstand names (HE1-HE7 Area E, HD1-HD2 Area D, HA1-HA5 Area A, HC1 / HCA / HC2 Area C) are the chart's numbers with an area prefix.
